newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Gazprom to pay Russia tax debts by end-June.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom to pay Russia tax debts by end-June.

text.p: Natural gas monopoly Gazprom will pay all its tax debts to the Russian government by the end of June, First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais said on Friday.

Chubais, who described reform of Gazprom as one of the main tasks facing the Russian government, said payments of 2.2 trillion roubles ($381.4 million) had already been handed over. "By the end of June Gazprom will pay all its debts to the Federal government," he told a news conference.
First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov has put total Gazprom debts to the government at 14.8 trillion roubles.
